_about: Rule positions (pt from the page's top-left, page 1) of Word 16's PDF of each fixture of scripts/fidelity/fid/table_fixtures.py, recorded by tables.py --record. Numbers only; no Word output is kept.

form_card.note: Word widens grid column 6 by 2.7 pt for a word that overflows its two columns by about 0.6 pt and takes it back from other columns; our AutoFit grows the two columns by what is missing only (up to 1.9 pt apart)

wide_auto160.known_gap: w:tblW auto with cell widths past the text column: Word fits the table into the column with its own width split (not proportional, not by content); we keep the widths below 1.5 times the column and scale them evenly above

wide_auto120.known_gap: w:tblW auto with cell widths past the text column: Word fits the table into the column with its own width split (not proportional, not by content); we keep the widths below 1.5 times the column and scale them evenly above
